Driveline and final drives

Heavy dropboxes, differentials and final drives come into the workshop for inspection, parts, repair or a full rebuild. Call with the make and model of the machine and we’ll talk you through it.

Call about a component
  1. InspectionFind out what is worn, cracked or out of tolerance.
  2. PartsReplacement parts sourced for the unit in front of us.
  3. RepairWorn and damaged components put right.
  4. RebuildThe complete unit rebuilt and ready to go back in.

Plate and structural fabrication

Carbon and stainless steel platework from 3 to 40 mm, cut, rolled and welded into the equipment and structures a plant runs on.
